payload.title: [server] Push adapters are never registered into a live PushRegistry at boot
payload.description: Found during the web-push port (FR-264): boot.rs constructs no PushRegistry/NotificationRouter and calls register_adapter for NO platform — every register_adapter call in crates/frick-server/src is in #[cfg(test)]. So APNs, FCM, and the new Web Push adapters all exist + are unit-tested but CANNOT deliver a real push: nothing populates the registry at startup with real transports (a reqwest-backed APNs/FCM/WebPush client). The PUSH_DELIVER_JOB_TYPE worker + admin_push routes are wired, but the registry they'd dispatch through is empty. Fix: in boot.rs, build a PushRegistry from per-tenant credentials + inject production transports, and register it on AppState so the deliver-job handler resolves a real adapter. Also: the live WebPushTransport must re-screen DNS-resolved endpoint IPs at send time (SSRF), per the FR-264 note.
